Both feel right. When I ran the half-finished search, it didn't just throw up its hands or silently show me a random subset — it told me plainly what was missing ("after OR, add another condition and close the bracket") and, importantly, left my library showing exactly what it was showing before. That's the reassuring part: a typo in my search doesn't disturb what I was already looking at.

And the empty result for `tag:astronomy` — a tag I've never used — was handled honestly too: a clear "nothing matches this" rather than a blank confusing screen, with a one-click way straight back to my full library. That matters because a search turning up nothing is normal, and I shouldn't feel stuck when it happens.

So yes, both behaviors are what I'd want. What's next?
